q1_what_did_you_play: I played both copies of Kaboom! on Fuzzy Wurm Crawler, then Duck and Cover, dealing 14 damage and gaining 5 Block against the telegraphed 4 damage.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing only both copies of Kaboom!, since that dealt the same damage, but it would leave the incoming attack unblocked.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up nothing immediately available: the Spark cards were unplayable, and Duck and Cover did not reduce the damage dealt by the two playable attacks.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy had not intended to deal damage, I would have omitted Duck and Cover because its Block had no other stated benefit.
